content.text: Coachella Music Festival Tickets Coachella Music Festival ignites the desert each April at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California, uniting global artists and fans for two consecutive three-day weekends. Across landmark stages like the Coachella Stage, Outdoor Theatre, Sahara Tent, Yuma, and the art-forward Do LaB, cutting-edge performances span pop, hip-hop, indie, electronic, Latin, and more. Towering art installations transform the polo fields, curated food and beverage keeps energy high, and on-site camping and late-night sets create an immersive, sun-to-stars festival experience.Buy Coachella Music Festival tickets from Vivid Seats for secure checkout, stress-free mobile delivery, our 100% Buyer Guarantee, and Rewards that help you earn toward future shows. What should I bring to a music festival? Music festival essentials usually include your ticket or wristband, ID, cash or card, a refillable water bottle, portable phone charger, sunscreen, comfy shoes and a light jacket or poncho in case of weather changes. Be sure to check the festival's rules for what's allowed as every festival has its own policies. Are there official Coachella Music Festival aftershows? Many festivals host official aftershows featuring artists from the main lineup as well as special guest performers. These events typically take place at nearby clubs, theaters, or venues after the festival grounds close. How do aftershow tickets work? Aftershows require separate tickets from the main festival pass. Availability is limited and often sells out quickly, especially for smaller venues or artist headliners. Some events are 18+ or 21+, depending on the venue. What should I wear to Coachella Music Festival? Comfort and weather-ready gear are key. Opt for breathable, layered clothing, comfy shoes for walking and standing, and sun protection like hats or sunglasses. Where can I buy Coachella Music Festival merchandise?
